newsitem.title: UK: Vickers flat, awaiting analysts meeting.
newsitem.headline: Vickers flat, awaiting analysts meeting.

text.p: Shares in Vickers Group were unchanged after an initial dip as traders awaited feedback from the company's meeting with analysts.
By 0807 GMT, the shares were flat at 271-1/2p, after trading as low as 265p immediately after Vickers reported its first half results.
The British automotive and defence engineering concern posted pre-tax profits of 31.8 million stg in the first half, well within analysts' forecasts.
It said it expects to make further progress in earnings in the second half of the year.
